name: Mathway
tagline: Mathway is an AI-powered maths calculator and solver that handles problems from basic arithmetic through calculus, statistics, and linear algebra. Students photograph or type a maths problem, and the app solves it with step-by-step explanations. With over 100 million problems solved, it is one of the most used maths tools globally.
